points.name: apps.compass.calibration_icon
points.interpretation: The calibration view sets compass.bin as its icon.

points.name: apps.compass.calibration_hint
points.interpretation: The calibration view displays the localized hintdown.calibration.

points.name: apps.compass.scale_normal
points.interpretation: The compass view sets scale2.bin; refresh toggles its visibility according to the calculated heading.

points.name: apps.compass.scale_zero
points.interpretation: The compass view sets scale3.bin; refresh toggles its visibility according to the calculated heading.

points.name: apps.compass.north_icon
points.interpretation: The compass view sets N.bin and later rotates the object during refresh.

points.name: apps.compass.east_icon
points.interpretation: The compass view sets E.bin and later rotates the object during refresh.

points.name: apps.compass.south_icon
points.interpretation: The compass view sets S.bin and later rotates the object during refresh.

points.name: apps.compass.degree_unit
points.interpretation: The compass view initializes its degree-unit label with the degree symbol.

evidence: The compass page creates an allocated state and calibration view. The sensor callback may build the compass view on observed calibration states 3 or 4; resume can rebuild either view. The compass view sets its directional image sources, and the refresh routine subsequently rotates the corresponding objects and formats the heading through a separate variadic function.
scope: Only the listed calibration and view initialization setters while compass page state is active. Sensor measurements, calibration completion and formatted heading updates are not intercepted.
limitations: Direction icon replacements change visible orientation indicators without changing sensor results. Image resources must remain valid while used. State slots are not thread barriers; shared-entry publication and rollback require system-wide quiescence. Device behavior remains unverified.
